python -u -c 
# Use curl_cffi which mimics real browser TLS fingerprint, may bypass AWS WAF
import subprocess, sys
try:
    import curl_cffi
    print(f'curl_cffi available, version {curl_cffi.__version__}')
except ImportError:
    print('curl_cffi not installed — installing...')
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', 'curl_cffi'])
    import curl_cffi
    print('installed')
